entries.title: Esther 10:1
segments: And king Ahasuerus laid a tax on the land and [on] the isles of the sea.

entries.title: Esther 10:2
segments: And all the acts of his power and of might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, with which the king made him great, [are] they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

entries.title: Esther 10:3
segments: For Mordecai the Jew [was] next to king Ahasuerus and great among the Jews, and pleasing to the multitude of his brothers, seeking the wealth of his people and speaking peace to all his seed.
